decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several types of backpacks, including cooler bags, hydration packs, and specialized gear bags. The QT&QY Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) was the most compelling choice because of its high utility as a general-purpose backpack, its exceptional review count (over 6,000), and its high average rating of 4.7. At $39.99, it offers the best balance of features, durability, and value compared to specialized options like the skate pack or cooler packs, which had mixed reviews regarding quality or niche use cases.
